evidence.quote: During its last quarterly conference call, management forecast that it expects hyperscaler spending to top $1 trillion in 2027 after reaching a projected $650 billion in 2026 .
evidence.one_line: Nvidia management forecast hyperscaler spending above $1 trillion in 2027, after a projected $650 billion in 2026.
evidence.speaker: Nvidia management, as reported by Keithen Drury
evidence.event_time: Last quarterly conference call; date not stated

evidence.quote: For the rest of this year, they expect 82% growth. For 2027, that figure rises to 41%.
evidence.one_line: Wall Street analysts projected 82% growth for the rest of 2026 and 41% growth for 2027; the passage does not specify the metric.
evidence.speaker: Keithen Drury, reporting Wall Street analysts' projections

evidence.quote: For fiscal 2028, ending January 2028, the average analyst projects $12.76 in earnings per share.
evidence.one_line: The average analyst projected Nvidia FY2028 earnings per share of $12.76.
evidence.speaker: Keithen Drury, reporting the average analyst projection

evidence.quote: If we use that figure and value the stock at a reasonable earnings multiple of 25, the projected share price at the end of fiscal 2028 is $319.
evidence.one_line: Keithen Drury estimated a $319 Nvidia share price at FY2028-end, using projected EPS of $12.76 and a 25-times earnings multiple.
evidence.speaker: Keithen Drury

evidence.quote: As a result, I think the stock could easily reach $300 per share sometime in late 2027.
evidence.one_line: Keithen Drury forecast that Nvidia shares could reach $300 sometime in late 2027.
evidence.speaker: Keithen Drury
